card.name: "In" before a table reference
card.fires_on: The word "in" right after a passive verb like "are listed", "is shown" or "are provided", where the next word is likely "Table". Seen in dosing and results sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Dosing tables
modes.description: "in" after listed/provided/shown for dosage adjustments, such as for renal impairment.
modes.example: Dosage adjustments are listed<< in>> Table 2 [see Clinical Pharmacology

modes.label: Results tables
modes.description: "in" after presented/shown for trial data or dose estimates.
modes.example: Pooled data from the short-term, placebo-controlled schizophrenia and bipolar mania trials are presented<< in>> Table 3.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "table" next and discourages "figure" or "fig".
card.plain: It fires on the "in" that comes just before a pointer to a table, such as "shown in Table 1".
